name: Camping beim Fischer
beschreibung: Camping beim Fischer is located in the village of Münsing in Tirol and is designated as a year-round campsite. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, some of which are divided into pitches. The sanitary facilities are cleaned regularly and include showers and WCs in separate cubicles. A small kiosk on the site supplies guests with fresh rolls and basic groceries. The adjacent forest is ideal for short walks, and cycle paths are directly accessible. Water sports opportunities can be found at the nearby lake, whose shore can be reached on foot from the site. A barbecue area is available for communal use.
